narr: Deep monsoon moisture continued across northern Arizona with several flash floods.
ev: Water was flowing across a one mile stretch of Highway 61 west of St Johns between mile markers 362 and 363.

Heavy rain over the southern slopes of Mt Elden caused flash flooding in northeast Flagstaff. The water overwhelmed drainage systems and was flowing rapidly down streets (up to two feet deep). A video on social media showed a Prius floating down the street and crashing into a full sized pick-up truck. Water was flowing 6 feet deep in a low water crossing. Famous Route 66 had 2 feet of water flowing over it in town.

A flash flood rushed down the Tatahatso Wash/Slot Canyon into the Colorado River (38 miles down stream from Lees Ferry). A commercial river trip with 30 people and two large raft had set up camp at the mouth of the wash for the night. The flash flood washed away the camp. Four people were injured and one person died.
